test_cases.title: Page not found error page shows its heading
acs: DERIVED: /ErrorPageNotFound.aspx shows h1 Page not found - route /ErrorPageNotFound.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/ErrorPageNotFound.aspx.
steps.expected: The page loads and the address path is /ErrorPageNotFound.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Page not found.

steps.action: Reload the page.
steps.expected: The h1 still reads Page not found.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No unhandled server error page is shown; only the Page not found page is displayed.

test_cases.title: Unknown route returns HTTP 404
acs: DERIVED: An unknown route such as /DoesNotExist.aspx returns HTTP 404 - route /DoesNotExist.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.
/DoesNotExist.aspx is an address that does not exist in the application.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/DoesNotExist.aspx.
steps.expected: The server responds with HTTP status 404.

steps.action: Check the response status code in the browser developer tools network tab.
steps.expected: The status code for /DoesNotExist.aspx is 404 and not 200 or 500.

steps.action: Check the page content for a server error message.
steps.expected: No HTTP 500 server error page is shown.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx again.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing, so the site still works after the 404.
